recipes.name: Kumandra Soup inspired by Raya and the Last Dragon
ingredients: 6 oz oyster mushrooms, separated or sliced
3 Juice of limes (or to your taste)
instructions: Peel and devein the shrimp, leaving the tails on. Reserve the shrimp and the shells. - ½ lb fresh head on shrimp
Fill a large pot two-thirds of the way full with water. Begin heating the water over high heat.
Add the shrimp shells to the water and bring the mixture to a boil for 15-20 minutes, or until the water becomes slightly orange and fragrant.
Meanwhile, cut the lemongrass into 3-inch portions and bruise/crush the stalks with the butt of your knife. - 2 lemongrass stalks + more for garnish
Strain out the shrimp shells and add the lemongrass, lime leaves, and galangal. Boil the soup for 7-10 minutes. - 5 ½ dried makrut lime leaves torn - 5 ½ slices dried galangal
Add the reserved shrimp and mushrooms. Allow the soup to cook for an additional 3-5 minutes, or until the shrimp is cooked. - 6 oz oyster mushrooms separated or sliced
Turn the heat off and add the fish sauce, lime juice, and chili paste. Stir to combine. - 3 Juice of limes (or to your taste) - 1 ½ tbsp (Nam Prik Pao) chili paste - 2 tbsp fish sauce

Finish the soup with the shrimp paste, Thai chilies, bamboo shoots, palm sugar, and more thinly sliced lemongrass. - 5 ½ tbsp shrimp paste - 4 red thai chilies thinly sliced - 11 slices bamboo shoot - 2 tsp palm sugar - lemongrass stalks + more for garnish
Season the soup to taste with kosher salt and garnish with cilantro leaves. - To taste kosher salt - To garnish: Cilantro
Ladle the soup into smaller bowls and serve immediately.
